title: MAVLink Blank Message
text: Create blank MAVLink message bus by specifying payload information and MAVLink message type, 1 output; {MAVLink dialect source} sets the source for specifying the MAVLink message definition Select from standard MAVLink, {MAVLink dialect} sets the message definition to parse for MAVLink messages, {MAVLink version} sets the mAVLink protocol version, {MAVLink Message type} sets the mAVLink message, {System ID}, {Component ID} and {Sample time} sets the interval between outputs. Values come from the instance.

params.name: MAVLink dialect source
params.values: Source for specifying the MAVLink message definition Select from standard MAVLink dialects (default) | Specify your own

params.name: MAVLink dialect
params.values: Message definition to parse for MAVLink messages common.xml (default) | string
